shortBulletSummary: Crypto Markets Plunge: Bitcoin touched its cycle low near $59K, and Ethereum plunged to a 14-month low amid broad market weakness.
Hawkish Fed Fears: Strong US jobs data increased fears of a hawkish Federal Reserve and potential rate hikes, driving a risk-off sentiment across markets.
ETF Outflows Continue: Bitcoin and Ethereum spot ETFs experienced continued significant outflows as capital shifts to AI stocks.
Extreme Fear Dominates: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index remains in Extreme Fear (12-33), signaling pervasive caution among investors.
Mixed ETH Signals: Ethereum saw high exchange inflows but also a prominent evangelist selling ETH; whale accumulation is noted.
